    • blocks

      Schematic.Builder blocks(BlockVolume volume)
      Specifies an archetype volume for the world data of the schematic. This is to take part of the schematic, so it should not be referenced outside of the schematic, less modifications are going to be made also affecting the block entity volume.
      Parameters:
      volume - The archetype volume
      Returns:
      This builder, for chaining
